channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Death toll in Karnataka bus tragedy mounts to seven
item.description: At least six people were burnt alive, and 21 others suffered burns after a sleeper coach bus caught fire following a collision with a container truck in Chitradurga district of Karnataka on Thursday.

item.title: ‘Hindutva, patriotism of BJP and CM Fadnavis is hypocrisy’: Shiv Sena(UBT) in Saamana
item.description: The Shiv Sena Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray (UBT) on Friday criticised the BJP and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, saying that their version of Hindutva and patriotism was hypocrisy.

item.title: Seven killed in two roads accidents in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: The accident occurred near Ankireddypalem under the limits of Nallapadu Police Station when the car driver stopped the vehicle by the roadside. The private travel bus rammed into the car from behind.

item.title: Bangladesh: Awami League leader accuses Yunus-led interim govt of fostering radical Islamist forces
item.description: Former Bangladesh Minister and Awami League leader Mohammad Ali Arafat accused the Muhammad Yunus-led interim government of turning the country into a hub of radical Islamist forces.

item.title: ‘Through visionary leadership, he empowered India economically’: Rahul Gandhi on Manmohan Singh’s death anniversary
item.description: Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, on Friday paid tribute to former Prime Minister Dr Manmohan Singh on his death anniversary, describing him as a visionary leader whose policies empowered India economically and strengthened the nation’s global standing.

item.title: Manmohan Singh played transformative role in shaping modern India: Cong on leader’s death anniversary
item.description: The Congress on Friday paid tributes to former Prime Minister Dr Manmohan Singh on his death anniversary, remembering him as a visionary leader who reshaped India's economic trajectory and expanded opportunities for millions through far-reaching reforms and inclusive governance.

item.title: HM Shah to inaugurate Northeast’s largest auditorium in Assam
item.description: He described the project as a tribute to the state's rich artistic and cultural legacy and a major step towards strengthening cultural spaces in the region.

item.title: ​US H-1B rule shift alarms Indian tech workers, diaspora families
item.description: For Indian nationals—who account for a large share of H-1B approvals and dominate the long employment-based green card backlog—the shift is being closely watched as a potential restructuring of how foreign talent enters the US technology workforce.

item.title: 66 pc of existing users eager to purchase property in India’s RRTS corridors: Report
item.description: The Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) in the country is emerging as a strong catalyst for corridor-led investment, with nearly 80 per cent of surveyed existing users associating improved RRTS connectivity with enhanced economic opportunities in their region, a report showed on Friday.

item.title: Minimum temperature rises above zero in J&K’s Srinagar; cold wave grips Gulmarg, Pahalgam
item.description: The minimum temperature in Jammu and Kashmir's Srinagar city rose above the freezing point, while at Gulmarg ski resort and Pahalgam hill station it remained below the freezing point on Friday.
